name: VLBiasBench
description: VLBiasBench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating social biases in large vision-language models across nine distinct categories of bias and two intersectional categories. It contains 128,342 samples generated from 46,848 images combined with various question types to assess bias from multiple perspectives.
reputation: A recent and fairly comprehensive benchmark that has been used in the vision-language bias literature, though it is still not as established as older bias benchmarks.
notes: Large-scale dataset with diverse bias categories; uses synthetic images generated by Stable Diffusion XL.
